shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && echo --- && cat /workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null && echo --- && git -C /workspace log --stat -1
cat /workspace/.gitignore && echo --- && ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__ && echo --- && ls /workspace/node_modules | head -50 && node -v && npm -v

rm -rf data && PORT=3999 node server.js & sleep 1
curl -s -X POST localhost:3999/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"first read"}'
echo
curl -s -X POST localhost:3999/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Foundation","author":"Isaac Asimov"}'
echo
curl -s localhost:3999/api/books
echo
kill %1 2>/dev/null

PORT=3999 node server.js & sleep 1
ID=$(cat data/books.json | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(d)[0].id))")
curl -s -X PATCH localhost:3999/api/books/$ID -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"finished"}'
echo
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3999/book/$ID
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3999/book/does-not-exist
cat data/books.json
kill %1 2>/dev/null
